label: Early Phillips: religious belief is itself the expression of a moral vision, and the praising and…
paraphrase: Early Phillips (WF-P1, as reported): religious belief is itself the expression of a moral vision, and the praising and the glorifying does not refer to some object called God; the expression of such praise and glory is what is called the worship of God. A claim about the activity of praise; it does not itself say that the name 'God' applies to no being (that broader thesis is STMT-GOD-NAMES-NO-BEING-WF-P1, unattributed).
